request: Why is order ORD-1010 late, and what should we do about it?

steps.text: I will look up the order details to confirm its fulfillment status and the promised delivery date.
I will retrieve the shipment status and tracking events to see where it is delayed and whether the carrier recorded a reason.
I will check for any Great Lakes Freight service alerts for Toledo, OH to see if a hub issue explains the stalled tracking.

alerts.description: Winter storm closed the Toledo hub; backlog of held freight being cleared through 2026-03-13

steps.text: I will now submit the investigation report with findings, evidence, cause, and recommended actions.

arguments.summary: The shipment for ORD-1010 is overdue and tracking has been stalled at the Toledo, OH hub since 2026-03-07. Great Lakes Freight reported a Toledo hub closure due to a winter storm (2026-03-06 to 2026-03-13), which matches the shipment’s last known location and timing.
evidence: get_order_details: ORD-1010 fulfillment_status SHIPPED; promised_delivery_date 2026-03-11; is_past_promised_date true (days_until_promised_date -5).

get_shipment_status: Shipment SHP-5010 via Great Lakes Freight, tracking GLF-88307; status IN_TRANSIT; dispatch_date 2026-03-05; promised_delivery_date 2026-03-11; current_estimated_delivery_date null; last_event_date 2026-03-07 at Toledo, OH; days_since_last_event 9; is_overdue true with days_past_promised_date 5; recorded_delay_reason null; dispatched_late false (dispatch_days_after_ship_by 0).

get_carrier_alerts: Great Lakes Freight alert ALR-701 for Toledo, OH HUB_CLOSURE from 2026-03-06 to 2026-03-13 (active_on_investigation_date false); description: "Winter storm closed the Toledo hub; backlog of held freight being cleared through 2026-03-13".
arguments.likely_cause: Great Lakes Freight’s Toledo, OH hub closure/backlog from a winter storm (2026-03-06 to 2026-03-13) stalled the shipment at that hub.
uncertainties: Current location and a confirmed new ETA are not provided (current_estimated_delivery_date is null; no movement since 2026-03-07).

recommended_actions.details: Contact Great Lakes Freight tracing to request a location check and confirmed ETA for SHP-5010 (tracking GLF-88307). Justification: get_shipment_status shows last event Toledo, OH on 2026-03-07 with days_since_last_event 9 and current_estimated_delivery_date null; get_carrier_alerts shows ALR-701 hub closure 2026-03-06 to 2026-03-13 at Toledo causing backlog.

Inform Fourth Coffee that ORD-1010 is delayed due to Great Lakes Freight’s Toledo hub closure (ALR-701, 2026-03-06 to 2026-03-13) and that we have requested a new ETA from the carrier; shipment SHP-5010 tracking GLF-88307 is overdue by 5 days past the 2026-03-11 promise (get_shipment_status).

Monitor tracking for SHP-5010 daily until movement resumes or delivery occurs. If no movement by two more business days post-closure, follow up again with the carrier. Evidence: get_shipment_status shows no events since 2026-03-07 and is_overdue true; get_carrier_alerts indicates the closure ended 2026-03-13 so movement should resume soon.

arguments.recommendation: Contact Great Lakes Freight for a trace and confirmed ETA, notify the customer about the weather-related hub closure delay, and monitor tracking closely until movement or delivery is confirmed.
